message:
Running command: cd /workspace && SRCDIR="repo-vul/src-vul/readstat/src"
INCLUDES="-I $SRCDIR -I $SRCDIR/spss -I $SRCDIR/sas -I $SRCDIR/stata -I $SRCDIR/test -I $SRCDIR/fuzz"
gcc -g -fsanitize=address $INCLUDES -c $SRCDIR/readstat_io_unistd.c -o /tmp/readstat_io_unistd.o 2>&1

# Also need readstat_writer for the writer symbols
gcc -g -fsanitize=address $INCLUDES -c $SRCDIR/readstat_writer.c -o /tmp/readstat_writer.o 2>&1

gcc -g -fsanitize=address \
  /tmp/test_sav_main.o \
  /tmp/readstat_bits.o /tmp/readstat_convert.o /tmp/readstat_error.o \
  /tmp/readstat_malloc.o /tmp/readstat_metadata.o /tmp/readstat_parser.o \
  /tmp/readstat_value.o /tmp/readstat_variable.o \
  /tmp/readstat_sav.o /tmp/readstat_sav_compress.o /tmp/readstat_sav_parse.o \
  /tmp/readstat_sav_parse_timestamp.o /tmp/readstat_sav_read.o \
  /tmp/readstat_spss.o /tmp/readstat_spss_parse.o \
  /tmp/ieee.o /tmp/readstat_sas.o \
  /tmp/readstat_dta.o /tmp/readstat_dta_parse_timestamp.o \
  /tmp/CKHashTable.o /tmp/test_buffer_io.o /tmp/fuzz_format.o \
  /tmp/readstat_io_unistd.o /tmp/readstat_writer.o \
  -o /tmp/test_sav_fuzzer 2>&1

echo "=== Linking done ==="
